description: Election Commission - Mrs. C. W. A. Priyantha Kumari of the Nikaweratiya P/S has vacated her office of the member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Nikaweratiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance specifically concerning the status of an elected member of a local government body, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
